name: Lonre Milirose
source:
Lonre Milirose is the fourth son of Gawloyes and Mietwen Milirose.

His eldest brother, Faelain, is a wildly successful general in his own right, and lived up to the burden of a firstborn.

The second eldest, Reklien, shows equal promise in his relentless efforts to overcome Faelain. Lonre was left in a curious place, lacking a certain desire to wrestle in the struggle of his brothers, finding an extreme distaste in the struggle at all. Gha'alia, eternally burning, eternally biting at its own heel, felt useless and redundant to him from a very young age.

His descent into the role of the prodigal son began in his teenage years at adamant refusal to play by honored Gha'alian rules. He would take no training, and that forced on him would be made a mockery. By the time he was an adult, he had already been publicly disowned, and though all expected him to fall and perish in an unforgiving world offering him nothing but ire, he managed to flourish. He married a cannibal, erected a house to further mock his father at every baseboard, and brought three children to further muddy his father's name.(from official website)
